title: P-role5: §5 non-banned role means banned-role identity
description: room-policy-04 §5 fixed_membership: only role 0 or 'non-banned' roles... Chosen: 'banned' means Role::is_banned_role() (index 1 named 'banned'); so with fixed_membership a role 1 with another name holding canAddParticipant is rejected.
